_note: Demo cohort for the Dashboard app's 'Patients Tomorrow' panel. Patient records sourced from meridian-onboarding's demoPatients (~/GitHub_Repos/meridian-onboarding/index-rendered.html lines 4914-5371). opportunities[].details[].text fields carry inline <span class="opportunity-smartphrase"> and <span class="opportunity-code"> markup that the patient-detail view renders via dangerouslySetInnerHTML.

hardStops.text: Concurrent opioid + benzodiazepine — document risk discussion and naloxone Rx
CKD Stage 3a — avoid NSAIDs, verify renal dosing on all medications
LDL 142 on atorvastatin 20mg — consider uptitration to high-intensity dose
Active stimulant (Vyvanse) — document BP and HR at this visit
CKD without cystatin C on file — order to confirm staging

opportunities.summary: ASCVD risk counseling — review PREVENT score and statin intensity

details.label: Clinical context
details.text: Patient is on low-dose atorvastatin 20mg with LDL 142. Based on CKD + HLD + HTN risk profile, current guidelines recommend high-intensity statin therapy. Consider uptitration.

details.label: Documentation
details.text: Use smartphrase .prevent to document PREVENT risk score review and statin therapy decision.

details.label: Billing
details.text: May apply code G0537 for cardiovascular risk assessment counseling.

details.label: Payer note
details.text: UHC DSNP — no prior authorization required for high-intensity statin switch.

opportunities.summary: CKD monitoring — cystatin C and uACR due for annual screening

details.label: Clinical context
details.text: CKD Stage 3a (eGFR 45). Annual cystatin C confirms staging accuracy. uACR monitors for progression to nephrotic range.

details.label: Documentation
details.text: Use smartphrase .ckdscreen to document rationale for ordering. Pair eGFR + cystatin C + uACR as panel.

details.label: Billing
details.text: CPT 82610 (cystatin C), CPT 82570 (urine creatinine for uACR). Diagnosis N18.3.

details.label: Payer note
details.text: UHC DSNP — KED quality measure. Completing both eGFR + uACR closes the care gap.

opportunities.summary: Opioid + benzo overlap counseling — risk mitigation and naloxone

details.label: Clinical context
details.text: Concurrent oxycodone 10mg q6h + diazepam 5mg BID. CDC guidelines recommend documented risk discussion and naloxone co-prescribing.

details.label: Documentation
details.text: Use smartphrase .opioidrisk to document risk-benefit discussion. If prescribing naloxone, add .naloxonerx.

details.label: Billing
details.text: CPT 99401 for preventive counseling (15 min). Diagnosis F11.10 (opioid use, uncomplicated) or T40.2X5A if documenting risk.

details.label: Payer note
details.text: UHC DSNP — naloxone covered at $0 copay under opioid safety benefit.

opportunities.summary: Visit complexity add-on — multiple chronic conditions managed

details.label: Clinical context
details.text: Patient has 8 active problems spanning CKD, HTN, HLD, chronic pain, and ADHD. If visit addresses ongoing management of 2+ chronic conditions, complexity add-on is appropriate.

details.label: Documentation
details.text: Use smartphrase .nsg211 to document how management of one condition (e.g., CKD) intersects with another (e.g., HTN medication renal dosing, statin choice with CKD).

details.label: Billing
details.text: G2211 — add-on to E/M for visit complexity. Must document medical decision-making across conditions.

details.label: Payer note
details.text: UHC DSNP (Medicare) — G2211 billable for Medicare patients only. Requires same-day E/M 99213-99215.

hardStops.text: No diabetic eye exam on file — order or document screening
No diabetic foot exam documented this year
Statin not prescribed despite diabetes + LDL >100
Microalbumin/creatinine ratio >8 months old — reorder
HbA1c 8.2% — above target, consider therapy intensification

opportunities.summary: GLP-1 agonist candidate — A1c 8.2 + BMI 34.2, may improve both

details.label: Clinical context
details.text: A1c 8.2 on metformin alone, BMI 34.2 with diabetic neuropathy. GLP-1 agonist would address glycemic control and weight simultaneously.

details.label: Payer requirement
details.text: UHC DSNP requires documentation of: (1) trial of metformin ≥ 3 months, (2) A1c still above target. Both criteria met. Monthly follow-up visits documenting weight required for continued coverage.

details.label: Documentation
details.text: Use smartphrase .glp1start to document indication and payer criteria. At follow-ups, use .wtcounsel to document weight and interventions, supporting CPT 99401.

details.label: Billing
details.text: This visit: 99214 with diagnosis E11.9 + E66.01. Medicare also allows G0447 (intensive behavioral therapy for obesity) if using .mcintensivebh4obesity.

details.label: Additional codes
details.text: Diet counseling: .dietcounselMNT with CPT 97802. BMI documentation: Z68.34 for BMI 34.2.

opportunities.summary: Visit complexity — diabetes impacts HTN, neuropathy, and weight management

details.label: Clinical context
details.text: Managing diabetes alongside HTN (BP 148/92), obesity, and neuropathy. Medication choices for one condition affect others (e.g., GLP-1 helps weight + A1c, ACE titration for renal protection).

details.label: Documentation
details.text: Use smartphrase .nsg211 to document cross-condition complexity. Reference how diabetes management plan accounts for cardiovascular and renal risk.

details.label: Billing
details.text: G2211 add-on to E/M. Use most specific diabetes code: E11.42 (DM2 with diabetic polyneuropathy) rather than E11.9.

details.label: Payer note
details.text: UHC DSNP (Medicare) — G2211 billable. Requires same-day E/M 99213-99215.

details.label: Clinical context
details.text: Type 2 diabetes with LDL 158. ACC/AHA guidelines recommend moderate-to-high intensity statin for all diabetic patients age 40-75, regardless of ASCVD score.

details.label: Documentation
details.text: Use smartphrase .prevent to document cardiovascular risk assessment. Review PREVENT calculator results with patient.

details.label: Billing
details.text: G0537 for cardiovascular risk counseling. Pair with E11.9 and E78.5.

details.label: Payer note
details.text: UHC DSNP — high-intensity statin (atorvastatin 40-80mg, rosuvastatin 20-40mg) on formulary at Tier 1.

opportunities.summary: Diabetic retinal exam — overdue, schedule or document external result

details.label: Clinical context
details.text: No diabetic eye exam on file. ADA recommends annual dilated eye exam for all type 2 diabetics. Patient has neuropathy, increasing retinopathy risk.

details.label: Documentation
details.text: If ordering referral, document with diagnosis E11.319 (DM2 with unspecified diabetic retinopathy). If documenting external result, use quality code 2022F.

details.label: Payer note
details.text: UHC DSNP — closes GSD care gap for diabetic eye exam measure. Panel currently at 15% compliance.

hardStops.text: LDL 198 — high-intensity statin indicated per ACC/AHA guidelines
BP 158/94 — above target on 3 agents, consider add-on therapy
Estimated 10-year ASCVD risk elevated — lifestyle + pharmacotherapy discussion

opportunities.summary: High-intensity statin — LDL 198, guideline threshold exceeded

details.label: Clinical context
details.text: LDL 198 with family history of premature CAD and prediabetes. ACC/AHA: LDL ≥190 is automatic indication for high-intensity statin regardless of ASCVD score.

details.label: Documentation
details.text: Use smartphrase .prevent to document PREVENT risk assessment. Review calculated risk with patient as shared decision-making tool.

details.label: Billing
details.text: G0537 for CV risk counseling. Diagnoses: E78.5 (hyperlipidemia) + Z82.49 (family hx CAD).

details.label: Payer note
details.text: Humana MA — atorvastatin 40-80mg on preferred generic formulary. No PA required.

opportunities.summary: Resistant HTN counseling — BP 158/94 on 3 agents

details.label: Clinical context
details.text: BP 158/94 on losartan 100mg + HCTZ 25mg + metoprolol 50mg. Consider adding amlodipine or spironolactone. Rule out secondary causes if persists.

details.label: Documentation
details.text: Use smartphrase .htncounsel to document medication review, dietary counseling (sodium restriction), and plan for follow-up BP check.

details.label: Billing
details.text: Level 4 E/M (99214) supported by moderate MDM with medication adjustment. Add G2211 for complexity if managing HTN alongside prediabetes and HLD.

details.label: Payer note
details.text: Humana MA — controlling high BP is a STARS measure. Current panel at 55% control rate. Closing this gap moves the metric.

opportunities.summary: Prediabetes monitoring — A1c 6.1, annual recheck and lifestyle counseling

details.label: Clinical context
details.text: A1c 6.1 (prediabetes range 5.7-6.4). Obesity (BMI 30.1) is modifiable risk factor. Evidence supports intensive lifestyle intervention to prevent progression.

details.label: Documentation
details.text: Use smartphrase .dmprevention to document diabetes prevention counseling. If discussing weight, add .wtcounsel.

details.label: Billing
details.text: G0447 for intensive behavioral therapy for obesity (Medicare). Diagnosis: R73.03 (prediabetes) + E66.01 (obesity, BMI 30.0-30.9 → Z68.30).

details.label: Payer note
details.text: Humana MA — G0447 covered up to 22 visits in first year for BMI ≥30. No copay for preventive services.

opportunities.summary: Chronic pain management plan — document multimodal approach

details.label: Clinical context
details.text: Chronic low back pain on oxycodone 5mg q8h + gabapentin 300mg TID. Document multimodal pain management including non-pharmacologic interventions to support continued opioid prescribing.

details.label: Documentation
details.text: Use smartphrase .painplan to document pain assessment (functional goals, PEG score), current regimen review, and non-opioid interventions tried or planned.

details.label: Billing
details.text: 99214 supported by moderate MDM. Diagnosis: M54.5 (low back pain) + G89.29 (chronic pain).

details.label: Payer note
details.text: Aetna Commercial — requires PDMP check documentation for opioid continuation. Prior auth required if dose exceeds 90 MME/day.

opportunities.summary: Benzodiazepine risk assessment — concurrent opioid, consider taper plan

details.label: Clinical context
details.text: Clonazepam 1mg BID + oxycodone. FDA black box warning on concurrent use. Consider gradual benzodiazepine taper if clinically appropriate, or document clear justification for continuation.

details.label: Documentation
details.text: Use smartphrase .benzotaper to document risk-benefit assessment. If continuing both, use .opioidbenzojustify for informed consent documentation.

details.label: Billing
details.text: Follow-up visit 99213. Diagnoses: F41.1 (GAD) + F13.10 (sedative use, uncomplicated).

details.label: Payer note
details.text: Aetna Commercial — no PA required for benzodiazepine taper. Behavioral health referral covered at in-network rate.

opportunities.summary: Stimulant monitoring — document vitals and side effect screening

details.label: Clinical context
details.text: Adderall XR 30mg daily. Guidelines recommend periodic BP, HR, and weight monitoring. Document cardiovascular review and screen for abuse/diversion.

details.label: Documentation
details.text: Use smartphrase .stimmonitor to document vital signs review, side effect screening, and therapeutic benefit assessment.

details.label: Billing
details.text: 99214 if combined with medication management for multiple controlled substances. Diagnosis: F90.2 (ADHD, combined).

details.label: Payer note
details.text: Aetna Commercial — Adderall XR requires PA annually. Documentation of continued medical necessity supports renewal.

opportunities.summary: CKD complexity — managing anemia, hyperPTH, hyperkalemia, and HTN

details.label: Clinical context
details.text: CKD Stage 4 with 4 active complications: anemia (Hgb 9.2), secondary hyperparathyroidism (PTH 280), hyperkalemia (K 5.1), and hypertensive CKD. Each medication decision affects multiple systems.

details.label: Documentation
details.text: Use smartphrase .nsg211 to document how CKD management intersects with anemia treatment (iron/ESA decisions depend on renal function), PTH management (calcitriol dosing with phosphorus levels), and antihypertensive choices (ACEi/ARB with hyperkalemia risk).

details.label: Billing
details.text: G2211 add-on to E/M. Use most specific diagnosis: N18.4 (CKD Stage 4) + D63.1 (anemia of CKD) + E21.1 (secondary hyperPTH).

details.label: Payer note
details.text: UHC MA (Medicare) — G2211 billable. KED quality measure requires documentation of both eGFR and uACR.

opportunities.summary: IV iron evaluation — TSAT 15% and ferritin 45 despite oral iron

details.label: Clinical context
details.text: TSAT 15% + ferritin 45 on oral ferrous sulfate. KDIGO guidelines recommend IV iron for CKD patients with TSAT <20% and ferritin <100 who are not responding to oral iron. Hgb 9.2 suggests functional iron deficiency.

details.label: Documentation
details.text: Document trial of oral iron ≥ 3 months with inadequate response. Reference TSAT and ferritin targets. If referring for infusion, document medical necessity for IV route.

details.label: Billing
details.text: If administered in office: J1756 (iron sucrose) + 96365 (IV infusion, first hour) + 96366 (each additional hour). Diagnosis: D63.1 + E61.1 (iron deficiency).

details.label: Payer note
details.text: UHC MA — IV iron covered with prior documentation of oral iron failure. Submit with clinical notes showing TSAT < 20%.

opportunities.summary: Nephrology care coordination — document shared management plan

details.label: Clinical context
details.text: eGFR 22 approaching dialysis threshold. Coordinate with nephrology on: dialysis access planning timeline, medication adjustments, dietary restrictions (potassium, phosphorus), and advance care planning.

details.label: Documentation
details.text: Use smartphrase .ckdcarecoord to document coordination with nephrology, medication reconciliation, and patient education on CKD progression.

details.label: Billing
details.text: If ≥60 min/month of care coordination: 99487 (complex chronic care management). Requires patient consent on file. Alternatively, 99490 for 20+ min/month (standard CCM).

details.label: Payer note
details.text: UHC MA — CCM services covered. Must document time spent and activities. Cannot bill same day as E/M if using 99490.
